pages.title: A Combo Is Not Just Damage
pages.text: How a combo ENDS decides what happens next. A knockdown ender gives you okizeme - free pressure on their wakeup. Letting them air-recover next to you for nothing hands the turn straight back.

pages.title: RF While They Juggle
pages.text: A juggled opponent builds NO RF the whole ride - while yours keeps growing. Delaying juggle hits and ending with a tech trap stretches that free time out even further.

pages.title: Two Good Endings
pages.text: This lesson drills both: the knockdown ender that starts your okizeme, and the tech-punish ender that catches an opponent who recovers into the air carelessly. Pick by what your opponent tends to do.
